result.markdown:
# Availability Drop on S-TUN-008 due to Transport Failure

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-TUN-02-B`
- **Confidence:** high (Directly evidenced by LINK_LOS alarm on the parent link at the exact onset of the outage; maintenance, changes, and external events were checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-25 14:00 to 2026-09-25 21:15
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-25 14:00
- **Affected:** S-TUN-008, S-TUN-016, S-TUN-017

## Summary

Fiber link loss of signal (LINK_LOS) on LNK-TUN-02-B disrupted connectivity to S-TUN-008 and its sibling sites.

Availability for S-TUN-008 dropped to zero for approximately 7 hours along with active users and download traffic.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-25 14:00: Critical LINK_LOS raised on fiber link LNK-TUN-02-B [ALM-000550]
- 2026-09-25 14:00: Traffic, active users and availability drop alert ALR-0036 begins on S-TUN-008, S-TUN-016, and S-TUN-017 [ALR-0036, ANM-000380, ANM-000381, ANM-000382]
- 2026-09-25 14:01: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-TUN-008, S-TUN-016, and S-TUN-017 [ALM-000551, ALM-000552, ALM-000553]
- 2026-09-25 21:11: LINK_LOS alarm cleared on LNK-TUN-02-B [ALM-000550]
- 2026-09-25 21:15: Impact ended and availability recovered on S-TUN-008 [ALR-0036]

## Evidence

- S-TUN-008 experienced an availability drop to zero starting at 2026-09-25 14:00 and recovering at 21:15. [T1, ALR-0036, ANM-000381]
- S-TUN-008 shares fiber link LNK-TUN-02-B with sibling sites S-TUN-016 and S-TUN-017. [T2, S-TUN-008]
- A critical LINK_LOS alarm was raised on LNK-TUN-02-B at 2026-09-25 14:00. [T3, ALM-000550]
- No maintenance or configuration changes were scheduled or executed on the affected nodes and ancestors during the incident window. [T4, T5]
- No external events were recorded for region TUN during the incident timeframe. [T6]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-02-B: confirmed.  LINK_LOS alarm on parent fiber link LNK-TUN-02-B directly coincides with the site outages, and sibling sites experienced the same failure simultaneously. [T2, T3, ALM-000550]
2. **bad_change**: rejected. No changes were executed on S-TUN-008, LNK-TUN-02-B, AGG-TUN-02 or their parents during the window. [T5]
3. **planned_maintenance**: rejected. No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected nodes or their parents during the window. [T4]

## Ruled out

- T4: No maintenance windows were active or scheduled on the affected nodes or their parents.
- T5: No configuration changes were made on the affected nodes or their parents during the incident.
- T6: No external events were recorded for the region during the timeframe.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect fiber link LNK-TUN-02-B for physical damage or degradation.
- Review transport resilience and backup path configurations for LNK-TUN-02-B.
